objective: Unattended inspection of all 25 assembly slots without requiring a teammate's D435-trained model.

vrm_inspection_scope.approved_change: 2026-09-08 user accepts fully seated placement anywhere inside socket; right-wall 1mm process clearance is not an inspection defect criterion.
vrm_inspection_scope.retained: Missing, wrong orientation, actual socket exit and lip seating; uncertain evidence stays UNKNOWN.
vrm_inspection_scope.restriction: Removing RIGHT-only nomination does not certify socket containment, height, or overall PASS.

smd01_micro_seating_scope.reason: User agreed to defer micro lip seating after unstable normal warnings and ambiguous socket wall evidence.
smd01_micro_seating_scope.retained: Raw evidence, missing, rotation, and independent position checks; no PASS promotion.
smd01_micro_seating_scope.limitation: Small height-only defects may no longer receive a displayed seating candidate. This is scope reduction, not improved detection accuracy.

hbm_pin_candidate_scope.normal_reference_update: 2026-09-14 user-labelled normal capture210030_190048 now pins the reference. Separate captures210219_730052 and210342_852873 evaluated without fitting; zero HBM candidates in the latter, one in the former. Archived physical control retains three candidate slots. Thresholds and authority unchanged; fixed-slot comparison still confounds pose/occlusion and is not body-relative pin localization.
hbm_pin_candidate_scope.reference_quality_gate: 2026-09-14: same-side individual reference or visible-anchor insufficiency prevents long-band gap nomination; raw gap retained, UNKNOWN not PASS. Independent qualified-side per-pin candidates remain enabled. This reduces coverage of near-total dark/occluded pin rows rather than certifying their normality.
hbm_pin_candidate_scope.provider: same-slot reference-relative long pin-band gap plus legacy per-pin near-absence evidence and candidate circles
hbm_pin_candidate_scope.limitations: Does not certify single-pin defects, total dark-band absence, height, or placement. Missing reference, uncertain presence or invalid alignment abstains. No candidate is not PASS.
hbm_pin_candidate_scope.validation: Developmental same-session normal and partial-loss replay only; no production authority.

gpu_crack_candidate_scope.scope: Visible transverse dark ridge below GPU logo when optical contrast suffices; original fixed provider crop, no local pose normalization. Supplemental lighting was not confirmed for the development capture.
gpu_crack_candidate_scope.public_category: SURFACE_ANOMALY with GPU_TRANSVERSE_DARK_CRACK_CANDIDATE detail; existing ROS services and schema unchanged.
gpu_crack_candidate_scope.fragment_evidence: 2026-09-14 development repair: Hough near-horizontal fragments with strong blackhat >=12, minimum line span 0.06 crop width and bilateral raw median contrast >=8, darkest local ridge +/-3 and background offsets8--10px. Original contour rule retained; no local pose warp. Four current repeated defect views used as development data, not independent validation.
gpu_crack_candidate_scope.limitations: Development candidate: print seams, shadows and scratches not excluded. Weak frontal image abstains, absence is not PASS. Matched grazing-light normal/defect holdout remains required.

preprocessing_contract.learned_provider_input: registered original S22 color pixels without CLAHE
preprocessing_contract.opencv_local_input: grayscale CLAHE clipLimit=2.0 tileGridSize=8x8, with raw grayscale corroboration only when CLAHE saturation would erase physical contrast
preprocessing_contract.restriction: No preprocessing may normalize away slot-relative position or orientation defects.

stages.purpose: Reject stale, blurred, clipped, overexposed, or badly framed captures before inspection.
Perspective-rectify the fixture and board into the fixed 1600x1266 board frame.
Determine presence, slot-relative center, and in-plane angle for every expected component.
provider_order: S22 fixed-slot state classifier (VRM: EMPTY/CORRECT/ROTATED; other types: PRESENT/EMPTY)
slot-relative geometry and independent orientation-feature checks
stages.restriction: Texture-ambiguous segmentation masks cannot independently assert PRESENT; an unvalidated slot classifier remains ADVISORY_ONLY.

stages.purpose: Confirm orientation independently from the component detector.
checks: VRM fixed-slot CORRECT versus ROTATED state

stages.purpose: Inspect GPU/HBM white pins and fine local appearance using high-resolution slot ROIs.
provider_order: explicit white-pin row and continuity check
slot-level PatchCore or FR-PatchCore appearance candidate

stages.purpose: Screen for unexpected global appearance changes that the explicit slot checks did not describe.
stages.restriction: FR-PatchCore registration must not be used to excuse component position or orientation defects.

provider_contract.inductor_model_selection: 2026-09-14: inductor_current_candidate_v3_20260914 selected provisionally after stored controls and one fresh capture without Inductor surface nomination. Thresholds unchanged; ADVISORY_ONLY, no pose normalization, no certified PASS or broad lighting validation.
provider_contract.normal_only_surface_policy: 2026-09-14: normal_p99 appearance drift alone cannot nominate inductor SURFACE?; retain scores/maps and UNKNOWN. Controlled fail_min and independent orientation/position checks remain enabled.
provider_contract.low_confidence_policy: Return UNKNOWN; never convert a weak score into PASS.

fusion_policy.pass: Every required stage for every expected slot is calibrated, available, and PASS.
fusion_policy.fail: At least one calibrated authoritative stage reports a confirmed FAIL.
fusion_policy.unknown: Any required stage is missing, stale, uncalibrated, contradictory, or low-confidence.
fusion_policy.unknown_runtime_action: Automatically recapture and rerun; after the configured retry limit, hold the board or route it as NG_UNCERTAIN without an operator PASS override.
fusion_policy.model_degradation: Continue all independent stages. A degraded or unavailable model removes only its own vote and cannot make the board PASS.
fusion_policy.human_role: Dataset review and threshold validation during development only; no human visual decision in the target production loop.

data_policy.normal_training_rule: Only verified correctly assembled S22 captures may enter normal training.
forbidden_normal_variation: slot-relative component shift outside socket tolerance
allowed_normal_variation: board-level camera pose variation removed by registration
lighting variation that has been separately validated

operational_decision.authorization: 2026-09-11 user explicitly requests imperfect PASS/FAIL due deadline
operational_decision.policy: PASS when all 25 presence checks are positive, registration and gross quality valid, providers available and no displayed defect candidates. Otherwise FAIL. Disabled experimental VRM seating excepted.
operational_decision.limitation: Accepts uncalibrated pin/surface/orientation coverage. Does not certify accuracy or promote providers. Original fusion retained as validated_decision.
operational_decision.vrm_presence_fallback: For UNKNOWN VRM state, accept existing independent PRESENT summary only if conflict=false and probability >=0.9; not a validated direction/pose vote.
operational_decision.position_unknown_policy: 2026-09-13 user clarification of existing provisional behavior: position UNKNOWN alone does not reject a board if all operational gates pass. Do not suppress displayed position/other defect candidates, provider errors, registration/quality/presence rejection or validated FAIL. Preserve raw stage UNKNOWN and validated_decision; provisional PASS is not certified position normality.
operational_decision.public_decision_policy: 2026-09-13 user requests no UNKNOWN in operator decisions. ROS/HTTP result and state events use PASS/FAIL; legacy inconclusive results fail closed on read without modifying archives. Slot/finding decisions are operational; demo confirmation below is a separately authorized presentation policy, not provider promotion. Raw validated_decision, diagnostic stages and status-bearing measurements remain local rather than public result fields. Existing service names and schemas remain unchanged.

demo_confirmation.authorization: 2026-09-13 user explicitly approves confirming candidates for a portfolio project after being informed they are unverified.
demo_confirmation.policy: Only a complete provisional FAIL with sole reason DEFECT_CANDIDATE may expose existing advisory findings as AUTHORITATIVE/confirmed_defect=true in ROS/HTTP results, with matching defects and counts. Authority is the user-approved demo disposition policy, not a calibrated model.
demo_confirmation.provenance: Retain source_authority/source_confirmed_defect and explicit decision_basis/confirmation_policy in the response. Archive raw provider evidence unchanged. Do not train on demo confirmations as verified labels.
demo_confirmation.exclusions: No invented defects for missing data, capture quality, registration or provider errors. Does not certify real-world defect accuracy or change S22 fusion, geometry, model validation, robot or conveyor safety.
